people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.
translations.bsb: For just as the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, so also through Christ our comfort overflows.
translations.kjv: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
translations.asv: For as the sufferings of Christ abound unto us, even so our comfort also aboundeth through Christ.
